title: Austin Convention Bureau & City Budget Review
summary:
*   Reviewed the financial health and management of the Austin Convention and Visitor Bureau.
*   Discussed the Convention and Visitor Bureau's annual budget.
*   Held a key planning session for the city's operating budget for the upcoming fiscal year.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - August 30, 1988 - 9:00 A.M Council Chambers, 307 Wat Second
Street, Austin, Texas Mayor Cooked called to order the special called meeting of the
Council, noting the absence of Councilmerabers Urdy and Carl-Mitchell.
Mayor Cooke announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a vorksession on discussion
of the Austin Convention and Visitor Bureau, Inc., Mid-Year Management/ Program Financial
Audit and Annual Budget. A worksession was also held on Operating Budget fo FY 1988-89.
Council adjourned its meeting at 12:00 noon.
